author: Chris Ruch
text: Happens to me often. I called Abbott and spoke with someone about it, who explain that the pressure in the sensor pushes the fluid away from the filament, causing a low reading. Bad! I had my insulin adjusted because of lows in the middle of the night. I find it happens more when I first put in my sensor. I put the sensor on the front of my arm and it still happens. And has happened when my cat is asleep on my arm 😸
